user.title: Set up Propane Tracker
user.description: Describe the tank. Deliveries fill it, and a fuel meter on a propane appliance drains it, so the level behaves like a battery's charge. Appliances with no meter are reconciled at each fill.

data_description.tank_capacity: The nameplate size of the tank, in US gallons.
data_description.fill_percent: How full the delivery driver leaves the tank. Residential tanks stop at 80%, which is also what the tank's own gauge reads when full.
data_description.meter_entity: A total-increasing sensor measuring propane burned by one appliance, such as a water heater's accumulated energy.
data_description.meter_units_per_gallon: How many of that sensor's units equal one gallon of propane. Use 26.81 for kWh, and adjust it if fills say the meter reads high or low.

init.title: Propane tank
init.description: Changing these re-reads the tank model. The delivery ledger is not affected.

record_delivery.name: Record delivery
record_delivery.description: Record a propane tank fill as durable ledger data, backdated statistics, and a refill of the tracked tank level.

delivery_date.name: Delivery date
delivery_date.description: The date printed on the delivery ticket or bill.

gallons.name: Gallons delivered
gallons.description: The number of US gallons added to the tank.

cost.name: Invoice total
cost.description: What the delivery cost. Give this or price per gallon, not both.

price_per_gallon.name: Price per gallon
price_per_gallon.description: The billed commodity price for one US gallon.
